meta.title: Mediaory — Communication Intelligence Platform
meta.description: Monitor, understand, and act on what the world is saying about your brand. News, web and social in one loop: watch, filter, understand, alert, report.

footer.tagline: Communication intelligence for teams that need to know first — and know why.

hero.subtitle: Mediaory watches news, web and social around the clock, folds the noise into stories, and tells your team what matters — with the evidence attached.
hero.note: Set up your first monitor in under three minutes.
hero.screenAlt: The Mediaory dashboard showing mention totals, an AI summary of the last 24 hours and a mention trend.

sources.label: Watches the places your audience actually talks

story.title: From noise to a decision,
story.lead: Scroll through how a single question — “what is being said about us?” — becomes an answer your leadership can act on.
story.listLabel: How Mediaory works, step by step

watch.title: Tell it what to watch.
watch.body: Brands, executives, competitors, campaigns. Build a query with simple chips or full Boolean syntax — it is the same query either way — and pick your sources.
watch.alt: The new monitoring form with include, exclude and exact-phrase fields and source checkboxes.

filter.title: Cut the noise, keep the signal.
filter.body: Filter by sentiment, priority, date and owner. Duplicates collapse, so one story carried by thirty outlets shows up once — with every source attached.
filter.alt: The mentions table with search and sentiment, priority, date and assignment filters.

understand.title: Know why it matched — and what it means.
understand.body: Every mention explains why it was picked up and carries an AI summary with its confidence and method. No black boxes, no unsupported claims.
understand.alt: A mention detail drawer showing why it matched, sentiment, an AI summary with confidence, tags and feedback.

alert.title: Get pinged for what matters.
alert.body: Keyword, high relevance, spike, sentiment shift, emerging topic, competitor and creator alerts — with cooldowns, so the inbox stays calm.
alert.alt: The new alert form listing keyword, high relevance, spike, sentiment shift, emerging topic and competitor alert types.

report.title: Hand leadership a finished report.
report.body: Weekly summaries, monitoring overviews, or a custom build. Export to PDF, CSV or XLSX, or put it on a schedule and forget it.
report.alt: The new report form with weekly summary, monitoring overview and custom templates.

why.title: Intelligence you can defend in the boardroom.
why.lead: Speed is easy. Being right — and showing your work — is the product.

grounded.title: Grounded AI
grounded.body: Every insight ships with evidence, sources and a confidence score. If the data does not support a claim, Mediaory does not make it.

honest.title: Honest data
honest.body: Reach and engagement show as “Not available” when a source does not report them. Never estimated silently.

alerts.title: Alerts that do not cry wolf
alerts.body: Grouping, thresholds and cooldowns turn a flood of duplicates into a handful of signals worth opening.

teams.title: Built for teams
teams.body: Organizations, projects and role-based access. Assign mentions, comment, tag and hand off — from analysts to executives.

social.title: Social listening
social.body: Conversations, authors and hashtags in one view — including the unprompted brand chatter that never tags you.

control.title: Your data, your control
control.body: Tenant isolation, retention policies, data export and deletion — privacy is a feature you can operate, not a promise.

devices.title: At the desk. In the room. On the move.
devices.lead: The same signal follows you from a wide analyst workspace to the phone in your pocket when something breaks after hours.
devices.laptopAlt: The Mediaory analytics view with mention volume and sentiment trend charts.

soon.title: Where Mediaory goes next.
soon.lead: We build in the open with our users. These are in design now — tell us what would make them useful for you.

groups.title: Brand groups
groups.body: Cluster your own brands and your competitors separately, then compare the two sides in one view.

charts.title: Chart & table builder
charts.body: Build your own charts and tables from your monitoring data and drop them straight into reports.

credits.title: Pay for what you track
credits.body: A credit system priced by the keywords you actually monitor, instead of one-size-fits-all tiers.

cta.title: Know first. Know why.
cta.body: Set up a monitor, watch the first mentions land, and see how much quieter a day can be.

phone.alertBody: Hourly volume is well above the trailing 24-hour baseline.
phone.m1: Northwind Blog Network expands into a new region
phone.m2: Analysts discuss Northwind Blog Network’s market position
phone.m3: Customers react to Northwind Blog Network’s latest update
phone.m4: Northwind Blog Network announces quarterly results

hero.title: Everything from raw coverage to a decision,
hero.lead: Built for communications, PR and brand teams who are done stitching together five tools and a spreadsheet.

monitoring.title: Monitoring & query builder
monitoring.body: Track brands, products, executives, competitors and topics with a chip-based simple mode or full Boolean syntax — the same query, either way. Preview what a query would have matched before you save it.
points: News, web, social, video, podcasts, forums and comments

dedupe.title: Deduplication & story clustering
dedupe.body: The same story from 30 outlets shows up once, with every source attached — not 30 separate alerts. Filter by sentiment, priority, date and owner, and search across everything.
points: Assign, tag and comment as a team

ai.title: Grounded AI insights
ai.body: Executive summaries, risk signals and recommendations — every claim linked to the mentions and metrics behind it, with confidence and method shown. Ask follow-up questions in plain language.
points: “Why did this match?” on every mention
Confidence, method and evidence on every insight
Multi-turn AI assistant grounded in your data
ai.alt: A mention drawer with an AI summary.

alerts.title: Alerts that do not cry wolf
alerts.body: Spike, sentiment-shift, emerging-topic, competitor and creator alerts with grouping and cooldowns — delivered in-app, by email or to Slack and Teams through webhooks.

analytics.title: Analytics that answer “so what?”
analytics.body: Mention volume, sentiment trend, source distribution and topics over the period you choose — plus a cross-platform view of how a story travels.

reports.title: Reports on your schedule
reports.body: Daily digests and weekly or monthly reports, from templates or a fully custom report builder — exported to PDF, CSV or XLSX and shareable with a link.

more.title: And the details that make it work for real teams.

items.title: Roles & permissions
items.body: Built-in roles plus custom ones you define.

items.title: Internal API keys
items.body: Connect Mediaory to the rest of your stack.

items.title: Webhooks
items.body: Push alerts into Slack, Teams or your own systems.

items.title: Data retention
items.body: Set how long mentions are kept, automatically enforced.

items.title: Light & dark
items.body: A workspace that respects your eyes and your OS.

hero.title: One platform,
hero.titleAccent: every team that has to know first.
hero.lead: Corporate communications, PR agencies and brand teams all ask the same question. Mediaory answers it for each of them.

comms.title: Corporate communications
comms.body: Catch developing stories early, see how sentiment moves after an announcement, and brief the executive team with a report that cites its sources.
points: Early warning on spikes and sentiment shifts

pr.title: PR & agencies
pr.body: Run many clients from one place. Separate projects, role-based access and share links keep every account organized and every deliverable one click away.

brand.title: Brand & marketing
brand.body: Understand campaigns in the wild — who is talking, on which platforms, and in what tone — including the conversations that never tag your brand.

crisis.title: Crisis & risk
crisis.body: When minutes matter, alerts reach the right people first, mentions can be assigned on the spot, and everything is logged for the review afterwards.
points: Tags and comments kept with the mention

cta.title: Not sure which fits?
cta.body: Tell us how your team works today and we will show you the shortest path.

hero.title: Your intelligence stays
hero.lead: Mediaory is designed so that what you monitor, how you monitor it and who can see it are decisions you control.

tenancy.title: Tenant isolation
tenancy.body: Every organization’s data is strictly separated. Cross-tenant access is covered by an automated test suite that runs on every change.

rights.title: Content rights
rights.body: Mediaory fetches public content responsibly: it respects robots.txt, identifies itself, and stores what is needed to give you the signal.

control.title: Data control
control.body: Set retention policies, export your data, and delete your account or organization. It is your data, and leaving is a button, not a support ticket.

secure.title: Secure by default
secure.body: Hardened sessions, CSRF protection, rate limiting, SSRF-safe fetching and role-based permissions come standard — not as add-ons.

cta.title: Have a security questionnaire?
cta.body: We are happy to walk your security team through the details.

hero.title: Get the most out of
hero.lead: Guides and reference material for going from first login to a monitoring setup you trust.

start.title: Getting started
start.body: Set up your first monitoring query and see live results in under three minutes — covered step by step in onboarding right after you sign up.

syntax.title: Query syntax
syntax.body: Boolean search made simple: AND, OR, NOT and exact phrases for precise monitoring queries — or stay in chip mode and never type an operator.

api.title: API & webhooks
api.body: Reference documentation for the Mediaory API and webhook events ships alongside the public API release.

hero.title: Pay for what you
hero.lead: We are finalizing a simple, usage-based model instead of fixed tiers. Early users help shape it — and are first in line when it launches.

credits.title: Credits, not tiers
credits.body: A single pool of credits you spend on what you monitor — no jumping to a bigger plan for one extra feature.

keywords.title: Priced by keyword
keywords.body: Cost follows the keywords you track, so a focused setup stays affordable and a broad one scales predictably.

free.title: Start free
free.body: You can create an account and set up your first project today, before pricing is announced.

cta.title: Want to shape it?
cta.body: Tell us what you monitor and what you would expect to pay. We read every reply.

hero.title: Talk to a human,
hero.lead: Have a question about Mediaory for your team, a security review, or an idea? Reach out and we will get back to you.

card.title: Email us
card.body: The fastest way to reach the team.
card.note: A contact form with routing ships in a later release.
